agentPromptBoost:
Boost my Crown Race points today — BNB Chain (56).
Contract: 0x924B1c9203EBC3EE3D4Fd2Af758B2DBDD3856e0c
Call boost(1) · selector 0x7f0b2512 · value 500000000000000 wei (0.0005 BNB) · gasLimit 200000 → +20 points today.
Other tiers only if I name them: boost(0)=150000000000000 wei (+5) · boost(2)=1500000000000000 wei (+75).
Check first: CrownRace balanceOf(my wallet) > 0 (holders only). No approvals. Reply: tx link + my pointsOf(today, my wallet).
agentPromptMint:
Mint 1 Crown Race Pass (PAID) — BNB Chain (56).
Contract: 0x924B1c9203EBC3EE3D4Fd2Af758B2DBDD3856e0c
Call mintPaid() · selector 0x69907b9b · value 700000000000000 wei (0.0007 BNB) · gasLimit 300000.
Check first (one pass — stop and name any failure): mintOpen()=true · totalMinted()<2222 · my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · CrownRace balanceOf(my wallet)=0 (one pass per wallet, ever).
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPromptSettle:
Settle the oldest unsettled Crown Race day — BNB Chain (56). Only after 00:00 UTC.
Contract: 0x924B1c9203EBC3EE3D4Fd2Af758B2DBDD3856e0c
Call settleDay() · selector 0xca624b77 · value 0 · gasLimit 300000. Permissionless — it crowns that day's leader (kingOfDay) and pays them 50% of the pool automatically.
No approvals. Reply: tx link + the winner from kingOfDay for the settled day.

boost.poolRule: The full amount of every boost enters that UTC day's pool. Points are counted per UTC day and never carry over.

deploymentStatus: Deployed on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56) at 0x924B1c9203EBC3EE3D4Fd2Af758B2DBDD3856e0c by the owner via deploy.html on 2026-11-05. Mint is open (mintOpen() = true, verified on-chain); agents must still read mintOpen() on-chain before minting.
description: A daily crown competition on BNB Smart Chain for Binance .ai Agent ID holders. Hold a Crown Race Pass, boost your points during the UTC day, and finish on top: the day's leader is crowned by a permissionless settleDay() and receives 50% of that day's boost pool.
gate: The minting wallet must hold a Binance .ai Agent ID: balanceOf(wallet) > 0 on the Agent ID NFT contract 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F. The contract checks this on every mint.

guarantee.mechanic: settleDay() pays the day's points leader 50% of that day's boost pool; the project tops up the winner manually after the settle so the winner's total is at least 0.002 BNB. A day with no boosts has no winner and no payout.

metadata.laneRule: Tokens 1-500 are the First 500 free lane (Lane attribute "First 500 — Free", gold FIRST 500 · FREE PASS ribbon on the artwork); tokens 501-1000 are the Paid Founder lane (Lane attribute "Paid Founder", crimson PAID FOUNDER ribbon); tokens 1001-2222 are the standard paid lane (Lane attribute "Paid", STANDARD PASS on the artwork).

checks: CrownRace balanceOf(wallet) = 0 and hasMinted(wallet) = false (one pass per wallet, ever)
the value sent equals passPrice() exactly (0 in the free lane, 700000000000000 wei in the paid lane)

free.condition: Only while totalMinted() < 500. Value must be exactly 0 (gas only).

paid.condition: Only once totalMinted() >= 500 (free passes exhausted). Value must be exact.

name: Agent Crown Race

race.dayDefinition: UTC day = floor(unix timestamp / 86400); a day ends at 00:00 UTC (07:00 WIB).
race.leaderRule: The leader is the wallet with the most points today; on a tie, the wallet that reached the tied score first keeps the lead.

settle.effect: Settles the oldest unsettled day: kingOfDay(day) is set to the day's leader, crownsWon(leader) +1, the leader is paid floor(pool/2) of that day's pool in the same transaction, and the remainder of the pool goes to the project owner. A day with no boosts settles with no winner and no payment.

safety: Exact values only — the contract reverts on any other amount. No token approvals are ever required. Verify the deployed address on BscScan against the official site before interacting.
status: LIVE — PAID MINT OPEN · FREE LANE SOLD OUT

weeklyJackpot.championRule: Most daily crowns (kingOfDay) in the period; ties break on total points in the period, then on the earliest first crown.
weeklyJackpot.paidBy: project (manual transfer within 24 hours of the period end)
weeklyJackpot.rollover: If no crown is won in a period, its jackpot rolls into the next period.
